subject: Mobile Development
title: The Death of the IDFA
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Death of the IDFA.

hook.text: Apple's IDFA let advertisers track you across apps. Then Apple let users turn it off.

buildup.text: The Identifier for Advertisers was the backbone of mobile ad targeting on iOS since 2012.

discovery.text: iOS 14.5 required apps to ask permission before accessing the IDFA. Most users declined.

twist.text: Apple's own advertising business grew 238% after restricting competitors' tracking abilities.

climax.text: The end of IDFA disrupted the entire mobile ad industry and shifted power back to Apple.

punchline.text: Apple killed ad tracking — then grew its own ad business.

quiz.question: What happened after Apple restricted the IDFA?
options: Most users declined tracking and Apple's ad business grew
